newsitem.title: CANADA: Brookfield files for C$500 mln of units.
newsitem.headline: Brookfield files for C$500 mln of units.

text.p: Brookfield Properties Corp said on Monday it filed an amended preliminary prospectus, dated January 21, to offer about C$500 million of units in a public offering.
Brookfield said each unit was composed of an equal dollar amount of convertible unsecured subordinated debentures and common shares and would be sold on an instalment receipt basis.
Brookfield's principal shareholder, Edper Group Ltd, owns about 94 percent of the issued and outstanding common shares on a fully diluted basis.
Edper agreed to purchase about C$200 million of the units, resulting in a dilution to its ownership interest to about 72 percent.
The offering was expected to be completed in the last week of January and close in early February, Brookfield said.
